content.title: Celanese Stock Dives 20% After Earnings Beat. What Has Wall Street Worried.
content.summary: Celanese  stock was tanking on Tuesday after the chemicals manufacturer said it was expecting demand to weaken in most of its key markets, overshadowing a second-quarter earnings beat.  The selloff came after Celanese reported adjusted earnings of $1.44 a share for the three months ended June 30, as sales climbed 6% from a year ago to $2.53 billion.  Analysts were expecting earnings of $1.40 a share on sales of $2.53 billion, according to a FactSet poll.
